$$
t(2,1)=f_y(2,1)i-f_x(2,1)j

$$

$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}t(x,y)&=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(4 x^{2} + x y - y)\,i-\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(4 x^{2} + x y - y)\,j \\ &=(x - 1)\,i-(8 x + y)\,j \\ t(2,1)&=(\left(2\right) - 1)\,i-(8 \left(2\right) + \left(1\right))\,j \\ &=(1)\,i-(17)\,j \\ &=i-17\, j\end{aligned}
